# `pumpkin-plugins`

> TypeScript plugins, shared tools, and GitHub Actions for Pumpkin Minecraft servers.

Plugins are WebAssembly components that run in Pumpkin's Static Hermes/WASI runtime by default; QuickJS can be selected in the package's build configuration. Source links below return Markdown from the repository; generated API links point to the [documentation site](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/). This file is generated from discovered guides, component documentation, package metadata, and API references.

## Getting started

- [Creating a plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/creating-a-plugin.md): The `pnpm gen` generator, what it creates, and what to do next
- [Creating an action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/creating-an-action.md): Create, document, test, and release a GitHub Action in this repository
- [Documentation site](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/documentation-site.md): Adding component guides, generated API reference, local preview, and publishing

- [BedrockAddonManager: Set up Bedrock packs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/bedrock-addon-manager/docs/setup.md): BedrockAddonManager scans the folder at startup and whenever you run /baddon reload, so it won't pick up new files automatically.
- [BedrockAddonManager: Troubleshoot Bedrock pack hosting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/bedrock-addon-manager/docs/troubleshooting.md): Start by checking that web.enabled is true and that /baddon list shows the pack.

- [DynamicLightsPumpkin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/dynamic-lights-pumpkin/docs/index.md): Server-side dynamic lights for held light sources
